description: This file contains the implementation of the ISC_History module for the SmartClient framework, including module initialization, version info, feature flags, and history management functions.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Provides methods for registering callbacks, managing history entries, and handling browser history state.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers callback functions for history changes.

methods.name: getCurrentHistoryId
methods.description: Returns the current history ID based on URL.

methods.name: addHistoryEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the history stack with associated data.

methods.name: historyCallback
methods.description: Invokes the registered callback when history changes.
